Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: Whatley
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/11/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 142 as introduced would add an additional six members to the nine-member Armory Commission and require the Armory Commission to meet at least twice a year. This would increase the administrative obligations of the Armory Commission by a minimum of $3,300 annually to reimburse the new members for expenses allowed under law and for the increased minimum meeting requirements for existing members.
Tom Whatley, Chairperson
Judiciary
